provenance.structure_source: Read from the text layer of the Midterm 1 papers of 2011, 2013, 2015 to 2019 (both 2019 versions) and 2024 in sources/cuatrimestre-1/03-engineering-mechanics/examenes/ (MECHANICS_FIRSTPARTIAL_*.pdf): mostly one problem with per-part marks that sum to 10 (2011 has two problems, 2013 prints no marks). The 2022 paper is a scan and was not read. No Midterm 1 paper prints its duration: the 60 minutes comes from the Quiz 2 (second partial) of 2015, which says "10 points, 60 minutes", and is an assumption for Midterm 1.
provenance.content_scope_source: Units 1 to 5 of the course (point-particle kinematics, dynamics, constraints, angular momentum and central forces, relative motion); rigid-body units belong to the second partial.
provenance.verify_when: The official duration and point split of Midterm 1 are confirmed; update this file and drop this note.

parts.label: Midterm problem
parts.description: One particle-mechanics problem of 10 points with 5 to 7 parts: kinematics, forces, equations of motion, a first integral and a particular case.
